title: REQ-20261103-OPS001 — Application pack summary: new Caldova Super (Select) account & super consolidation (Priya Natarajan, CS-2049817)
content:
Application pack emailed on 3 Nov 2026 by adviser Hannah Lewis CFP® (adviser code ADV-10442, Yarra Private Wealth, Collins St, Melbourne) for her client Priya Natarajan (DOB 14/02/1992, age 34; Southbank VIC 3006; priya.natarajan@example.com; 0491 570 156). Priya is a product manager who has just started a new job at a Docklands fintech. Her de facto partner is Arjun Mehta. She is busy and organised and wants it done digitally: 'I've got super scattered across old jobs — I just want one account, set up properly.' She is consolidating two external funds.

Pack contents: (1) Caldova Super (Select) application, signed and dated by Priya on 30 Oct 2026; (2) Statement of Advice dated 28 Oct 2026 — risk profile Growth; (3) investment instruction: Caldova Managed Portfolio — Growth, with the standard 1% minimum in the Caldova Cash Account; (4) rollover requests for two external funds — Southern Cross Industry Super (USI SCI0001AU, member 88213045, about $96,400, holds $520,000 Death & TPD cover) and Harbourline Retail Super (USI HRB0007AU, member HR-4471902, about $41,800, no insurance) — total about $138,200; (5) adviser fee consent: ongoing fee of $3,300 p.a. including GST deducted from super; (6) binding death benefit nomination: Arjun Mehta 100%; (7) employer super choice confirmation so future Super Guarantee contributions are paid to Caldova (Payday Super applies).

New member number: CS-2049817. Case opened: REQ-20261103-OPS001 (request type: New account & consolidation).

NIGO checklist: identity verified electronically (Document Verification Service — driver licence and Medicare card) ✅; TFN supplied (*** *** 774) ✅; application signed and dated ✅; adviser authority on file ✅; investment selection valid for Select and consistent with the SoA ✅; adviser fee consent meets SIS s99FA (written, signed, dated, dollar amount, services, 12-month term, can be withdrawn) ✅; KYC/AML screening — no PEP or sanctions match ✅; binding nomination ⚠️ only ONE witness — not valid as binding, recorded as non-binding until re-signed in front of two adult witnesses who are not beneficiaries; insurance ⚠️ the Southern Cross account holds $520,000 Death & TPD cover and the pack has no insurance-loss acknowledgement or replacement cover — that rollover must be held until the adviser and member confirm.

Routing: Financial Crime (KYC/AML screen — clear) → Benefits & Eligibility (fee consent, BDBN, TMD fit) → Transfers & Rollovers (request Harbourline now; hold Southern Cross pending insurance confirmation; SuperStream 3-business-day standard) → Investment Solutions (Growth model fit; compare Growth, Balanced and Index Balanced on $138,200) → Payments (invest each rollover in Growth on receipt, keeping 1% cash) → Client Communications (welcome email to Priya; adviser update to Hannah listing the BDBN re-sign and the insurance confirmation). Neither open item stops the account being opened.
